discourse_reference.note: Every mapped key exists in client.en.yml at both revisions with an equivalent English value; semantic equivalence reviewed per key (field 'verified').

rules: English (en): the app's bundled English; for a mapped key, a valid same-locale (en) site-text override replaces it.

Other locales, per key: (1) source 'discourse': that locale's own Discourse client translation (I18n no_fallback), with that locale's site-text override taking precedence when valid; (2) source 'fomio': the sparse overlay Localization/catalogs/<locale>.json; (3) otherwise the English value, listed in the catalog's 'fallback' array.
Reuse only semantically equivalent Discourse keys, verified per key with context (field 'verified'); never map on equal wording alone and never substitute words.

Overlays contain only source 'fomio' keys. A missing or invalid translation (markup, raw key, wrong placeholders, plural form outside the locale's categories, missing 'other' or 'other' without {count}) is replaced by English.

Plural categories per locale come from Discourse's CLDR rules (I18n 'i18n.plural.keys'); a plural message needs 'other' and may use only those categories; a missing selected form shows 'other', as in Discourse. Fallback (English) plural messages use English rules.
Convert Discourse %{name} to {name}, renaming per the entry's 'placeholders' map. Never apply an override from one locale to another.

terminology.decision: Native interface nouns stay 'discussion' (topic) and 'community' (category/subcategory) in every locale. Site-text branding overrides for topic/category keys are not mapped.
terminology.evidence: Public /extra-locales/<digest>/en/overrides.js on 2026-10-15 (inspected, not used by the app): topic keys -> Byte/Bytes, category keys -> Hub, subcategory keys -> Teret/terets; inconsistent casing (js.topic.new = 'new byte' vs js.topic.create = 'New Byte'); js.category.all overridden to the literal key 'js.hubs.all'. Only English has overrides.
terminology.to_adopt_branding: Add a reviewed terminology variant per locale for every key that contains the noun (search the English catalog for discussion/community/subcommunity), then map them together. Do not substitute words.
